name: RIIS
tagline: A rover enters collapsed buildings, spots survivors on video and starts AI triage before responders can go in.
problem: After a structural collapse, survivors die waiting for care that cannot reach them safely, the team says.
solution: A Raspberry Pi rover streams video to a command interface running YOLOv8-pose; four Fetch.ai agents then assess the patient (SBAR via ASI-1 Mini), place a multilingual voice call (ElevenLabs) and build a Gaussian-splat 3D scene viewable in a VR headset.
demo_moment: Team-described: drive the rover to a person, see the skeleton overlay, the triage note and the VR walk-through.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “2nd Overall” and “Fetch.ai: Best Use of ASI:One” among 307 submissions.
Moves the start of care to the moment of detection, before anyone enters.
A physical robot plus VR reconstruction gives judges a multi-layer live demo.

lessons: Put a physical robot on the table and let the AI handle the minutes after detection.
